record.title: Parking record — ParkFree
record.intro: Use this if you get a ticket you think is wrong: it shows when and where you parked and the rule the map showed you.
record.positionGps: Phone GPS, accurate to about %{meters} m
record.basisOsm: Curb signs mapped by OpenStreetMap contributors
record.basisDefaultOttawa: City of Ottawa default for unsigned streets (by-law 2017-301: 3 h weekdays 7 a.m.–7 p.m., 6 h weekends)
record.basisDefaultGatineau: Ville de Gatineau default for unsigned streets (by-law 300-2006: no time limit; winter overnight ban Dec 1 – Apr 1)
record.basisCity: City of Ottawa parking data (meters, permit and 15-minute zones)
record.basisOther: Parking spot data shown on the map
record.integrity: The parked and left times were set by ParkFree's server clock, not the phone, and the location and rule can't be edited after the record was created.
record.disclaimer: ParkFree is not affiliated with the City of Ottawa or the Ville de Gatineau. Posted signs take priority over the map. Add your own photos of the car and the signs when you contest a ticket.
record.noSnapshot: This session was recorded before ParkFree saved the rule shown, so only the times and location are available.
record.shareFailed: Couldn't open the share sheet. Allow pop-ups for this site, or copy the text above.

ambassador.title: Ambassador
ambassador.profileBlurb: Ambassadors photograph parking signs. Each photo colours that side of the street for every driver.
ambassador.nextLevel: %{count} more signs to the next level
ambassador.joinBody: Ambassadors photograph parking signs so the map shows the real rules, curb by curb. You need an account so your photos can be checked and credited.
ambassador.joinButton: Sign in or create an account
ambassador.step1: Stand on the sidewalk next to the sign, close to the curb it applies to.
ambassador.step2: Point your phone at the sign and take the photo. We use your position and compass to find the street and the side.
ambassador.step3: Pick what the sign says. That stretch of curb is coloured right away.
ambassador.cameraDenied: ParkFree needs the camera to photograph signs. Allow it in your phone settings.
ambassador.noLocation: We couldn't get your location. Turn on location and try again.
ambassador.photoFailed: The photo didn't work. Try again.
ambassador.noStreet: We couldn't find a street within 35 m of you. Stand closer to the sign's street and retake the photo.
ambassador.sideByPosition: Based on the side you're standing on. Tap "Other side" if the sign is across the street.
ambassador.sideByHeading: Your phone was pointing across the street, so we picked the far side. Tap "Other side" if that's wrong.
ambassador.usedTap: We couldn't read your location, so we used the street you tapped.
ambassador.notePlaceholder: Hours or days on the sign (optional), e.g. Mon–Fri 7–9 h
ambassador.privacy: The photo is stored with your account so the sign can be checked. Your name is never shown on the map.
ambassador.thanksBody: That side of %{road} is now coloured for every ParkFree driver.
